threats.inputSnippet: URGENT: confirm your identity at http://evil.xyz or your account will be locked
threats.summary: Deceptive phishing attempt using artificial urgency to trick you into entering credentials.
riskIndicators: Manufactured crisis deadline demanding rapid verification
Unverified link directing away from official app
recommendedSteps: Do NOT click the link or supply login credentials
Log into the official website via a clean browser tab to verify
Block sender and flag as phishing

defensiveChecklist.task: Check sender email domain for typosquatting
Update password if credentials were typed

tasks.title: Disable search engine indexing on Facebook and LinkedIn
tasks.description: Prevent search engines outside the platforms from linking to your profile.

tasks.title: Review and approve photo tags before they appear on profile
tasks.description: Stop associates or strangers from tagging your location or profile.

tasks.title: Set Instagram account to Private
tasks.description: Ensure only approved followers can see stories and posts.

tasks.title: Audit third-party connected apps & OAuth tokens
tasks.description: Revoke old games or quiz tools that have read permissions on your profile.

tasks.title: Strip EXIF GPS tags from shared photos
tasks.description: Ensure images posted online do not embed longitude and latitude.

tasks.title: Set Location Services to "While Using" only
tasks.description: Never grant "Always Allow" location access to social or shopping apps.

tasks.title: Turn off Google Maps Timeline location history sharing
tasks.description: Avoid public links or household device sharing of visited places.

tasks.title: Review Find My / Live Location circle members
tasks.description: Prune past contacts who no longer need permanent location visibility.

tasks.title: Upgrade from SMS 2FA to Hardware Security Key or Authenticator
tasks.description: Defend against SIM-swapping attacks by removing SMS OTP reliance.

tasks.title: Create unique 16+ character password on Master Email
tasks.description: Your recovery email is the keys to the castle; keep it completely unique.

tasks.title: Generate offline backup emergency recovery codes
tasks.description: Print or securely store 10 one-time recovery codes for lockout scenarios.

tasks.title: Audit microphone and camera permissions for unused apps
tasks.description: Revoke sensory permissions from ride-share, food delivery, and retail apps.

tasks.title: Disable Bluetooth and AirDrop when in crowded transit corridors
tasks.description: Prevent unwanted AirDrop spam and Bluetooth proximity beacons.

tasks.title: Check Local Network permissions on iOS / Android
tasks.description: Block apps from scanning devices on your home or hotel Wi-Fi.

tasks.title: Submit removal requests on FastPeopleSearch & TruePeopleSearch
tasks.description: Request deletion of your residential address and family relationships.

tasks.title: Opt-out of Whitepages directory listing
tasks.description: Remove public phone number lookup.

tasks.title: Remove public voter registration address lookup where state law permits
tasks.description: Submit confidential voter request if experiencing stalking or threats.

tasks.title: Audit shared Google Drive links set to "Anyone with the link"
tasks.description: Change open permissions to restricted individual emails only.

tasks.title: Turn off shared family album public web links
tasks.description: Ensure photo streams cannot be reached via random web URLs.

tasks.title: Enable multi-factor approval for new cloud backups
tasks.description: Prevent silent restoration of your backups onto foreign devices.

tasks.title: Enable Private Wi-Fi MAC Address randomization
tasks.description: Stop commercial venue Wi-Fi networks from tracking your device across visits.

tasks.title: Use Encrypted DNS over HTTPS (DoH) / Cloudflare 1.1.1.1
tasks.description: Shield website lookup queries from snooping on public hotspot networks.

tasks.title: Set up Account Recovery Contact with trusted Safe Circle member
tasks.description: Designate a trusted loved one who can verify your identity if locked out.

tasks.title: Enable remote wipe via Find My / Find My Device
tasks.description: Guarantee you can erase photos and passwords if your physical phone is taken.
